title: Executor report
description: The fixed report an executor ends with (design part 5.6), as parseReport returns it. Not a data file: the report is text, and this is its parsed form. A report written before HITLD-82, with status for result and runs for bench_runs, parses with a warning until the next minor release.

result.description: How the attempt ended (HITLD-82: was status).

commit.description: The branch's final commit; null when the executor made none (blocked before any).

evidence.description: Commands and their results, one per entry.

bench_runs.description: Benchmark run IDs with what each shows; empty for `bench_runs: none` (HITLD-82: was runs).

deviations.description: Departures from the plan or `touches`; empty for `none`.

questions.description: Anything for the orchestrator or a decider; empty for `none`.
